### Phase 1 — Ingest the Paper, the Review, & the Venue

**Read the review first.** Open `{suite}/_outputs/review-report.md` in full: confirm the HIGH-severity required-revision items are resolved in the current paper, and record any residual MEDIUM/LOW findings the operator chose to carry, together with the review report's not-judged list, as a known-state note in the publication record §1. Then read the paper deliverable at the host-natural location per the locate-before-read discipline at `rules/large-file-reading.md`, and resolve the venue from `--venue`, the suite context, or the structured-inquiry channel.

**The venue is the authority over the package shape.** Its author guidelines fix the template, the page or word limit, the bibliography style, the figure-format requirements, the anonymization rule (single- vs. double-blind), the required declarations (ethics, COI, data/code availability, author contributions, funding), and the preprint policy. Build the **venue-requirement inventory** — every artifact the venue demands and every declaration it requires — and externalise it to `{suite}/_inputs/venue-requirements.md` (a free-form `{kebab-case-topic}.md` scratch file per `rules/context-management-scratch.md` §1).

**Pin the target before reading any rule.** Fix four things first: the venue, the cycle (the year or the call), the track, and the article type. Ask the operator for whichever the suite does not state. Only that target's official pages are sources: a neighbouring venue, an earlier cycle, or a sibling track is never a stand-in, and the name of a style package is read from the venue's page, never inferred from the name an earlier package carried (the authority-before-invention floor at `rules/authority-inquiry.md`).

**Every inventoried rule carries its source and its stage.** Each rule (page or word limit, anonymity policy, required section, template or style-package name, link-freeze rule, figure format) is recorded with the official page it came from, the date that page was read, and the submission stage it governs: initial submission, response to reviewers, revision, or camera-ready. A rule with no official page behind it is asked of the operator through the structured-inquiry channel; the register records the operator's answer as its source with the date, and marks the rule as not verified against the venue (`rules/authoritative-referencing.md` §1 and §2). The dated inventory is copied into `{suite}/_outputs/publication-record.md` §1 as the venue-rule register, which is its required home; the scratch file stays an optional working copy. The stage in hand comes from the suite context or the operator, and Phases 2 to 4 enforce that stage's rules: a rebuild for a revision or for camera-ready reads that stage's limits from the register, never the initial-submission limits.

**Gather the authoritative declaration data** (author names, affiliations, emails, ethics-approval identifiers, funding sources, COI facts) from the suite where recorded and from the operator via required-category inquiry where absent — these are never invented (R6, `rules/authority-inquiry.md`).
